answer_1.quote: The ultimate goal of open-domain dialog systems is to provide an enjoyable experience to users. Previous research mainly focuses on optimizing automatic dialog evaluation metrics...

answer_2.quote: Our experiments show that HERALD achieves 86% accuracy in user disengagement detection in two dialog corpora... HERALD could quantify user engagement and be used as an automatic dialog evaluation metric.

answer_4.quote: Two dialog experts (co-authors of this paper) randomly annotated 134 dialogs and split them evenly into the test set and development set... They reached a high inter-annotator agreement score with kappa κ = 0.78.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators labeled each dialog turn as disengaged or engaged based on patterns such as complaints, topic dislike, termination requests, or non-positive responses.
